title: A domestication-selected enhancer coordinates source-sink balance to improve harvest index and yield in maize.
journal: Cell 189(17):5198-5213.e8, Aug 2026 (PMID 42480525, first published 2026-07-21). Europe PMC lists it as 'Subscription required': isOpenAccess=N, inPMC=N, inEPMC=N, hasSuppl=N, hasData=N, no PMCID. Crossref gives only an Elsevier TDM licence. No bioRxiv/Europe PMC preprint was found.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: No data files were found to open. These searches all returned nothing for this paper. NCBI elink from PMID 42480525 to gds, sra, bioproject and biosample: empty linksets. NCBI esearch of GEO/SRA/BioProject for BRR1, CONZ1, HI1 or 'harvest index' with Zea mays: 0 relevant hits (the teosinte-NIL BioProjects that came up are unrelated qKRN5.04b and Qgls8 studies). ENA study search: 0. CNCB/NGDC GSA and BioProject search for BRR1, CONZ1, 'harvest index' and 'teosinte enhancer': only unrelated organisms. Zenodo, DataCite and Dryad DOI/title searches: 0. The Figshare hits were irrelevant fuzzy matches. Europe PMC datalinks and the Annotations API give only 6 antibody RRIDs (e.g. anti-H3K27ac AB_10805234) from the key resources table, with no GEO/SRA/GSA accession text-mined. Crossref has 97 references and an empty 'relation' field.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: All of the following comes from the abstract or a secondary news article (bioengineer.org), not from files. HI rose 81% under domestication (teosinte mean 0.26 vs maize 0.47, per search snippet). The panel was 30 teosinte, 20 landraces and 50 modern inbreds. There are two maize-teosinte BC2S3 mapping populations, with about 20 QTLs (5 co-localized), NIL validation, and a 9.1-kb PAV enhancer 22 kb upstream of BRR1. Mechanism: CONZ1/GCN5 chromatin loop, H3K27ac ChIP. The data availability statement, supplementary table contents, per-line phenotype counts and any deposited RNA-seq/ChIP accessions could not be read because the full text is paywalled and I did not scrape the publisher site. The 866-line, 19,838-SNP W22 x parviglumis BC2S3 population is from a prior Tian-lab paper (PMC5363343, New Phytol 2017), which I retrieved. It is not confirmed to be one of the two populations used here.

a1_downloadable.note: Fail (checked by repository search). No open deposit is linked to the PMID/DOI in NCBI, ENA, NGDC/GSA, Zenodo, Figshare, Dryad or DataCite. The paper is paywalled and has no PMC copy, so supplementary tables are reachable only via the publisher site, which is out of scope. Raw sequencing may exist under an unlinked accession, but it is barred anyway.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not checked; I stopped at A1. Per-line harvest index would plausibly sit in a supplementary phenotype table for the BC2S3 lines and the 100-accession panel. I never saw it. The headline result (one PAV enhancer) is not a label table.

a3_inputs_present.note: Not checked. Genotypes for the BC2S3 lines would have to come from a prior resource (e.g. the 19,838-SNP set cited as Shannon 2012, a PhD thesis). Whether that matrix is public is unverified.

a4_units_stated.note: Not checked. HI is a dimensionless ratio (grain / aboveground dry biomass), so units are low-risk if a table were found.

a5_enough_rows.note: Not checked. The diversity panel is 100 accessions according to the news article, well under 400. BC2S3 population sizes in this paper are unknown. A prior Tian-lab BC2S3 population had 866 lines, which would still fall short of 1,500 for regression.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: Unknown. A per-line phenotype plus about 20k-SNP genotype table would be well under 100 MB if it existed.

a8_label_provenance.note: Not checked. HI is a field measurement, so it is not model output. But it is computed as grain weight / total biomass, so any feature set that includes yield or biomass components would leak the label by construction. Only genotype-only features would be clean.

existing_models.name: Washburn et al., 'Evolutionarily informed deep learning methods for predicting relative transcript abundance from DNA sequence' (PNAS 2019, PMC6431157)
existing_models.score_and_split: auROC 0.75-0.94 for mRNA expression level from sequence in maize. It uses gene-family-guided splitting and ortholog contrasts, per the abstract.
existing_models.authors_named_unsolved: Not stated in the abstract; the discussion was not read.

existing_models.name: AgroNT (Mendoza-Revilla et al., Commun Biol 2024, PMC11233511)
existing_models.score_and_split: The abstract claims SOTA on the Plants Genomic Benchmark (regulatory annotation, promoter strength, tissue expression, variant prioritization) but gives no number. Weights: huggingface.co/InstaDeepAI/agro-nucleotide-transformer-1b.

existing_models.name: Peleke et al., 'Deep learning the cis-regulatory code for gene expression in selected model plants' (Nat Commun 2024, PMC11045779)
existing_models.score_and_split: Over 80% accuracy for expression from gene-flanking sequence in Arabidopsis, tomato, sorghum and maize, with cross-species transfer. The split is not stated in the abstract.

backbone.name: AgroNT (plant DNA LM, open on HuggingFace) is the only matching backbone I retrieved. It is moot here: the paper characterizes one enhancer PAV (n=1), not a sequence-to-activity table.
backbone.hardware: Not assessed; there is no dataset to fit.
backbone.licence: Paper: Elsevier subscription/TDM. AgroNT licence not checked.

integration.partner_dataset: TeoNAM (Chen et al., Genetics 2019, PMC6827374) is a plausible public maize-teosinte mapping resource. Its data and whether it has an HI trait were not checked.
integration.join_key: None at row level: these are different populations. It could only align at QTL level via B73 genomic coordinates (build unknown).
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Cannot be written without per-line data from this paper, so the join is decoration (G4 = 0).

controls.positive_control: None definable without data. In principle the HI1 PAV genotype should explain a large share of HI variance in the BC2S3 lines.
controls.external_validation: Not applicable. TeoNAM is a hypothetical second population, not checked.

honest_claim_h3: No claim possible. With no released per-line data, nothing can be modelled. Even with data, the most a model could say is 'genotype predicts harvest index among BC2S3 lines from one lab's W22 x teosinte crosses grown in Chinese field trials'.
ml_idea: None viable. The hypothetical task is genomic prediction of harvest index from BC2S3 SNP genotypes (GBLUP/ridge vs gradient boosting), testing transfer between the two populations. It needs unreleased per-line tables, and n is likely under 1,500 per population.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Get the supplementary phenotype tables through a legitimate channel (library access or an email to the corresponding author, ft55@cau.edu.cn). Count the BC2S3 lines with an HI value, and check whether a public genotype matrix exists for those same line IDs. If there are fewer than about 800 lines or no public genotypes, kill it.

verdict_reason: A1 fails. The paper is paywalled with no PMC copy, and no dataset is linked or findable in NCBI, ENA, NGDC/GSA, Zenodo, Figshare, Dryad or DataCite. The science is a single-locus mechanistic study (one 9.1-kb enhancer PAV, about 100 accessions, two BC2S3 populations of unknown size), not a model-ready table.
